author: Nerd of the Rings
description:
During San Diego Comic-Con, I had the chance to catch up with our friend Jules German, creative director at Wētā Workshop!  We took a tour of their SDCC booth, including all the new pieces revealed like Théoden, Éowyn, Faramir, Rivendell and their new LOTR jewelry pieces!  Naturally, we also swing by their incredible Warhammer line to see things like Archaon the Everchosen from Age of Sigmar!

#wetaworkshop #lordoftherings #warhammer
title: Touring the Wētā Workshop SDCC booth! New statues revealed!
